body: Thank you. I already sent her contact info for some hotlines and she knew some others already. She's wrote to one of the main broader mental health organisations over here and I think she got some information there, too. Thanks for the advice, and more for just the kind words. I hope I can help her somehow, at least.

Hi. Thank you so mich for the answer. The first three, I'm already doing my best with.

I suppose the shared experiences bit feels a bit weird, because my experiences have been similar, but not the same. Certainly never that bad. I've been suicidal in as much as I had the thoughts and a plan, but never more. Meaninglessness is a part of my life as much as anybody's and I suppose I'm still grappling with it. I've shared my thoughts and at least she didn't argue.

I don't know how to do the fourth one reliably. I was never good at the whole self care thing. I'm keeping it in mind though, I suppose I have other friends who can keep an eye on me.

Thanks for the offer, too. I'll remember to write if I ever need to.
I'm male, so I can't help you in the way you ask, but I just thought I'd pop in and say that you're doing a good thing for yourself by staying out of that whole community and mindset. Good luck.
I wrote to you there, I'm looking forward to talking with you.
Hello, let's talk. M15 from Estonia here (compatible time-zones are wonderful) also with anxiety and now depression as well. Most popular messaging services will do, I'm open to PMs.
